name: The Fool
upright_meaning: New beginnings, optimism, trust in life. The Fool represents stepping into the unknown with childlike wonder. A fresh start filled with potential and excitement awaits.
reversed_meaning: Recklessness, fear of the unknown, risk-taking without thought. You may be holding back from a new experience or rushing in without preparation.
description: The Fool is numbered 0 — the number of unlimited potential. He stands at the edge of a cliff, ready to step into a new adventure with complete trust in the universe.

name: The Magician
upright_meaning: You have all the tools and resources you need to manifest your desires. Channel your willpower and focus to make things happen. Mastery of both spiritual and material worlds.
reversed_meaning: Manipulation, poor planning, untapped talents. Your skills may be misdirected or you're not utilizing your full potential.
description: The Magician channels the power of the universe through his will. With one hand pointing to the sky and the other to the earth, he bridges the spiritual and physical realms.

name: The High Priestess
upright_meaning: Trust your intuition and inner voice. Hidden knowledge is being revealed to you. Look beyond the surface and listen to your subconscious mind for guidance.
reversed_meaning: Secrets, disconnected from intuition, withdrawal. You may be ignoring your inner voice or withholding information from others.
description: The High Priestess sits between the pillars of light and darkness, guarding the mysteries of the subconscious. She represents deep intuitive wisdom.

name: The Empress
upright_meaning: A period of growth, abundance, and creativity. Connect with your nurturing side and embrace the beauty around you. Fertility and prosperity are flowing.
reversed_meaning: Creative block, dependence on others, emptiness. You may be neglecting self-care or feeling disconnected from nature and creativity.
description: The Empress embodies Mother Nature — lush, abundant, and nurturing. She represents fertility, beauty, and the creative force of life.

name: The Emperor
upright_meaning: Take charge of your situation with discipline and authority. Establish structure and order. Leadership and strategic thinking will guide you to success.
reversed_meaning: Domination, excessive control, rigidity. You may be too controlling or struggling against authority figures in your life.
description: The Emperor sits on his stone throne, representing solid foundations and unwavering authority. He is the father figure who provides structure and protection.

name: The Hierophant
upright_meaning: Seek guidance from established traditions, mentors, or spiritual teachings. Follow conventional paths and honor shared beliefs and institutions.
reversed_meaning: Rebellion, subversiveness, new approaches. You may be challenging traditions or seeking your own unique spiritual path.
description: The Hierophant is the bridge between the divine and humanity, representing spiritual wisdom passed through tradition and established institutions.

name: The Lovers
upright_meaning: A significant relationship or choice is before you. Align your actions with your values. Deep connections and harmony are possible when you choose authentically.
reversed_meaning: Disharmony, imbalance, misalignment of values. Relationship conflicts or difficult choices where your heart and head disagree.
description: The Lovers card represents the harmony of opposites and the power of choice. It speaks to deep connections and aligning with your true values.

name: The Chariot
upright_meaning: Harness your willpower and determination to overcome obstacles. Victory is within reach through focused effort and self-discipline. Stay the course.
reversed_meaning: Lack of control, aggression, obstacles. You may feel directionless or that opposing forces are pulling you apart.
description: The Chariot represents triumph through willpower. The charioteer controls opposing forces (black and white sphinxes) through sheer determination.

name: Strength
upright_meaning: True strength comes from within — through patience, compassion, and gentle persuasion rather than brute force. You have the inner courage to face any challenge.
reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, weakness, insecurity. You may be feeling vulnerable or lacking confidence in your abilities.
description: Strength shows a woman gently taming a lion, symbolizing that true power comes not from force but from inner courage, patience, and compassion.

name: The Hermit
upright_meaning: Take time for solitude and deep reflection. The answers you seek are within. Withdraw from the noise of the world to find your inner light and wisdom.
reversed_meaning: Isolation, loneliness, withdrawal. You may be isolating yourself too much or refusing to seek the guidance you need.
description: The Hermit stands alone on a mountain peak, holding a lantern to light the way. He represents the wisdom that comes from solitary contemplation.

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright_meaning: Life is always in motion. A turning point is approaching — embrace change and trust that the wheel turns in your favor. What goes around comes around.
reversed_meaning: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking cycles. You may be fighting against inevitable change or experiencing a downturn.
description: The Wheel of Fortune reminds us that change is the only constant. Cycles of fortune rise and fall — and destiny is always turning.

name: Justice
upright_meaning: Truth and fairness will prevail. Take responsibility for your actions and seek balanced outcomes. Legal matters or karmic justice are at play.
reversed_meaning: Unfairness, lack of accountability, dishonesty. You may be experiencing injustice or avoiding consequences of your actions.
description: Justice holds the scales of balance and the sword of truth. She represents karmic law — every action has a consequence.

name: The Hanged Man
upright_meaning: Surrender to the present moment. See things from a different angle. Sometimes progress requires letting go of control and embracing a new perspective.
reversed_meaning: Stalling, resistance, indecision. You may be delaying necessary sacrifices or refusing to see things differently.
description: The Hanged Man hangs suspended by one foot, serene and at peace. His inverted position offers a completely new way of seeing the world.

name: Death
upright_meaning: An important chapter is ending to make way for transformation. Release what no longer serves you. This is not physical death but profound personal metamorphosis.
reversed_meaning: Resistance to change, stagnation, fear of endings. You may be clinging to the past or refusing to let go of something that has run its course.
description: Death rides a white horse, symbolizing purification. This card represents the natural cycle of endings and new beginnings — transformation at its core.

name: Temperance
upright_meaning: Find the middle path. Practice patience and moderation in all things. Blend opposing forces into a harmonious whole. Spiritual and physical balance is key.
reversed_meaning: Imbalance, excess, lack of long-term vision. You may be overindulging or struggling to find equilibrium in your life.
description: Temperance carefully pours water between two cups, representing the flow of life and the alchemy of balance between extremes.

name: The Devil
upright_meaning: Examine your attachments and shadow patterns. Are you trapped by materialism, addiction, or unhealthy bonds? Awareness is the first step to freedom.
reversed_meaning: Release, breaking free, power reclaimed. You are breaking free from limiting beliefs, addictions, or toxic relationships.
description: The Devil chains two figures loosely — they could escape if they chose. This card represents the illusions and attachments that bind us.

name: The Tower
upright_meaning: Sudden, disruptive change is shaking your foundations. Though painful, this destruction clears the way for rebuilding on stronger ground. Truth is being revealed.
reversed_meaning: Personal transformation, fear of change, averting disaster. You may be resisting necessary upheaval or going through a quieter internal revolution.
description: Lightning strikes the Tower, toppling its crown. This card represents sudden upheaval that destroys false structures so truth can emerge.

name: The Star
upright_meaning: After the storm comes the calm. Hope, healing, and inspiration are flowing into your life. Trust in the universe and reconnect with your higher purpose.
reversed_meaning: Lack of faith, despair, disconnection. You may have lost hope or feel disconnected from your spiritual path.
description: The Star kneels by the water, pouring out healing streams under a sky of bright stars. She represents renewed hope after destruction.

name: The Moon
upright_meaning: Things are not as they seem. Navigate through uncertainty with your intuition. Hidden truths, dreams, and the subconscious are speaking to you.
reversed_meaning: Release of fear, repressed emotions, inner confusion. The fog is lifting and clarity is beginning to return.
description: The Moon casts an uncertain light on a mysterious landscape. Two towers flank a winding path between a dog and wolf — the tame and wild aspects of mind.

name: The Sun
upright_meaning: Pure joy, success, and vitality radiate through your life. Everything is coming together beautifully. Celebrate your achievements and share your warmth with others.
reversed_meaning: Inner child, feeling down, overly optimistic. You may be struggling to see the bright side or setting unrealistic expectations.
description: The Sun shines brightly on a joyful child riding a white horse. This card represents the purest form of happiness, success, and life energy.

name: Judgement
upright_meaning: A moment of deep self-reflection and spiritual awakening. Answer your higher calling. Evaluate your past actions with honesty and prepare for a rebirth.
reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, refusal of self-examination, stagnation. You may be avoiding an important personal reckoning or ignoring your inner calling.
description: An angel sounds the trumpet of judgement, calling souls to rise. This card represents awakening, self-evaluation, and answering the call of destiny.

name: The World
upright_meaning: A major cycle is complete. You have achieved wholeness and integration. Celebrate your accomplishments before beginning the next chapter of your journey.
reversed_meaning: Incompletion, shortcuts, delays. A goal remains unfinished or you are taking shortcuts that prevent true completion.
description: The World dancer floats within a laurel wreath, surrounded by four elemental creatures. She represents the successful completion of a life cycle.

name: Ace of Wands
upright_meaning: A burst of creative energy and new opportunities. Seize this moment of inspiration and take bold action on your ideas.
reversed_meaning: Delays, lack of motivation, missed opportunity.
description: A hand emerges from a cloud holding a sprouting wand — the spark of a new creative venture.

name: Two of Wands
upright_meaning: You stand at a crossroads with the world in your hands. Plan your next move carefully and embrace the journey ahead.
reversed_meaning: Fear of the unknown, lack of planning, playing it safe.
description: A figure holds a globe while gazing out from a castle, weighing future possibilities.

name: Three of Wands
upright_meaning: Your plans are gaining momentum. Expansion and growth are on the horizon. Look at the bigger picture and prepare for new territories.
reversed_meaning: Obstacles to progress, delays in plans, frustration.
description: A merchant watches ships sailing toward distant lands — commerce, travel, and expansion await.

name: Four of Wands
upright_meaning: A time for celebration and togetherness. Milestones are being reached, and joy fills your community and home life.
reversed_meaning: Lack of harmony, cancelled celebrations, feeling unwelcome.
description: Four wands form a canopy of flowers as people celebrate joyfully — a symbol of harmony and festivity.

name: Five of Wands
upright_meaning: Healthy competition or conflict of ideas. Multiple viewpoints clash, but this friction can spark growth and innovation.
reversed_meaning: Avoiding conflict, inner turmoil, relief from struggle.
description: Five figures brandish wands in a chaotic scene — a battle of wills and perspectives.

name: Six of Wands
upright_meaning: Public recognition and victory! Your hard work is being celebrated. Ride this wave of success with confidence and pride.
reversed_meaning: Private achievement, fall from grace, egotism.
description: A victorious rider on horseback, crowned with a laurel wreath, is cheered by the crowd.

name: Seven of Wands
upright_meaning: Stand your ground and defend your position. You are being challenged, but your determination and conviction will see you through.
reversed_meaning: Giving up, overwhelmed, admitting defeat.
description: A figure stands on high ground, fending off six wands from below — defending their hard-won position.

name: Eight of Wands
upright_meaning: Things are moving fast! Rapid progress, swift communication, and quick results. Ride the momentum and act decisively.
reversed_meaning: Delays, frustration, waiting, slowdown.
description: Eight wands fly through the air toward their target — pure velocity and directed energy.

name: Nine of Wands
upright_meaning: You are battle-weary but not defeated. Summon your remaining strength for the final push. Resilience and grit will carry you through.
reversed_meaning: Exhaustion, giving up, stubbornness.
description: A battered but standing figure grips a wand, backed by eight others — the last line of defense.

name: Ten of Wands
upright_meaning: You are carrying too much weight. Delegate, simplify, or let go of some responsibilities before you burn out.
reversed_meaning: Release of burdens, sharing the load, recovery.
description: A figure struggles to carry ten heavy wands toward a distant town — overwhelmed by responsibility.

name: Page of Wands
upright_meaning: A new creative adventure is calling! Approach it with youthful enthusiasm and curiosity. Explore freely without fear.
reversed_meaning: Lack of direction, procrastination, boredom.
description: A young messenger stands in a desert landscape, holding his wand and gazing at it with wonder.

name: Knight of Wands
upright_meaning: Charge ahead with passion and energy! Bold action and adventure are favored. Let your enthusiasm lead the way.
reversed_meaning: Haste, scattered energy, delays in travel.
description: An armored knight charges forward on horseback, wand raised high — the embodiment of fiery action.

name: Queen of Wands
upright_meaning: Radiate confidence and warmth. Lead with charisma and bold determination. Your magnetic energy draws success toward you.
reversed_meaning: Selfishness, jealousy, demanding nature.
description: A confident queen sits on her throne holding a sunflower and wand, with a black cat at her feet.

name: King of Wands
upright_meaning: Lead with vision and integrity. You have the charisma and strategic mind to bring your boldest ideas to life. Natural-born leader.
reversed_meaning: Impulsiveness, overbearing, unrealistic expectations.
description: A powerful king sits on a throne adorned with salamanders, holding a living wand — a visionary leader.

name: Ace of Cups
upright_meaning: A new wave of love and emotional fulfillment is entering your life. Open your heart to deep connections, compassion, and creative inspiration.
reversed_meaning: Emotional loss, blocked creativity, emptiness.
description: A hand offers a golden cup overflowing with five streams of water — the gift of emotional abundance.

name: Two of Cups
upright_meaning: A beautiful partnership or deep connection is forming. Mutual respect, attraction, and emotional harmony flow between two souls.
reversed_meaning: Breakup, imbalance, lack of harmony.
description: Two figures exchange cups in a gesture of mutual respect and love — the bond of true partnership.

name: Three of Cups
upright_meaning: Joyful gatherings, deep friendships, and creative collaborations. Celebrate life with your tribe and share your happiness.
reversed_meaning: Overindulgence, gossip, isolation from friends.
description: Three women dance joyfully, raising their cups in celebration — friendship, community, and shared joy.

name: Four of Cups
upright_meaning: Take time to reflect on what truly matters. You may be overlooking opportunities due to boredom or disillusionment. Look within.
reversed_meaning: Awareness, acceptance, moving forward after stagnation.
description: A young man sits under a tree, arms crossed, ignoring a cup offered by a mysterious hand.

name: Five of Cups
upright_meaning: Mourning a loss or setback. Allow yourself to grieve, but remember — two cups still stand behind you. Not all is lost.
reversed_meaning: Acceptance, moving on, finding peace after loss.
description: A cloaked figure mourns over three spilled cups, while two full cups remain behind — grief and hope coexist.

name: Six of Cups
upright_meaning: Revisit cherished memories and reconnect with your inner child. Nostalgia, innocence, and simple joys bring comfort and healing.
reversed_meaning: Living in the past, unrealistic memories, moving forward.
description: A child offers a cup filled with flowers to a younger child — innocence, nostalgia, and simple gifts of kindness.

name: Seven of Cups
upright_meaning: Many options and fantasies cloud your judgment. Ground yourself in reality and choose wisely. Not everything that glitters is gold.
reversed_meaning: Clarity, making a choice, overcoming confusion.
description: A silhouette gazes at seven cups floating in clouds, each filled with different fantastical visions.

name: Eight of Cups
upright_meaning: It is time to walk away from what no longer fulfills you. Seek deeper meaning and truth, even if it means leaving comfort behind.
reversed_meaning: Fear of change, stagnation, avoidance.
description: A cloaked figure walks away from eight stacked cups under a crescent moon — the courageous journey inward.

name: Nine of Cups
upright_meaning: The wish card! Emotional fulfillment and deep contentment are yours. Count your blessings and savor this moment of satisfaction.
reversed_meaning: Inner unhappiness, materialism, dissatisfaction despite having much.
description: A satisfied figure sits before a curved display of nine golden cups — the wish fulfilled.

name: Ten of Cups
upright_meaning: Ultimate emotional fulfillment and family harmony. Love, joy, and togetherness create a beautiful life. Your heart's desires are manifested.
reversed_meaning: Broken home, disharmony, misaligned values.
description: A joyful family stands under a rainbow of ten cups — the pinnacle of emotional happiness and domestic bliss.

name: Page of Cups
upright_meaning: A new emotional or creative message is arriving. Stay open to intuitive nudges and unexpected opportunities that stir your heart.
reversed_meaning: Emotional immaturity, creative block, insecurity.
description: A young page gazes curiously at a fish emerging from his cup — an unexpected message from the subconscious.

name: Knight of Cups
upright_meaning: Follow your heart with grace and charm. A romantic proposal, creative invitation, or emotional journey approaches with beauty and elegance.
reversed_meaning: Moodiness, unrealistic expectations, jealousy.
description: A knight in shining armor rides gracefully, offering a golden cup — the romantic hero on a quest of the heart.

name: Queen of Cups
upright_meaning: Lead with empathy and emotional intelligence. Your nurturing presence heals others. Trust your deep intuition and compassionate nature.
reversed_meaning: Emotional insecurity, codependency, inner turbulence.
description: A serene queen gazes into an ornate sealed cup — she holds the mysteries of the emotional realm.

name: King of Cups
upright_meaning: Master of emotional balance. You navigate turbulent waters with calm wisdom. Lead with both heart and mind in equal measure.
reversed_meaning: Emotional manipulation, moodiness, volatility.
description: A composed king sits on his throne amid turbulent seas, holding a cup and scepter — master of emotions.

name: Ace of Swords
upright_meaning: A powerful breakthrough in clarity and truth. Cut through confusion with sharp intellect. A new idea or perspective will transform your understanding.
reversed_meaning: Confusion, chaos, lack of clarity, misinformation.
description: A hand holds a crowned sword aloft, piercing through clouds — the ultimate symbol of mental clarity.

name: Two of Swords
upright_meaning: A difficult decision weighs on your mind. You must remove the blindfold and face the truth to choose your path forward.
reversed_meaning: Information overload, indecision, emotional confusion.
description: A blindfolded figure holds two crossed swords — caught between two equally weighted options.

name: Three of Swords
upright_meaning: Heartbreak and emotional pain pierce through. Allow yourself to feel the sorrow fully so healing can begin.
reversed_meaning: Recovery from heartbreak, forgiveness, releasing pain.
description: Three swords pierce a red heart under storm clouds — raw emotional pain and the beginning of healing.

name: Four of Swords
upright_meaning: Rest and recovery are essential now. Step back from the battlefield and restore your mental energy through quiet contemplation.
reversed_meaning: Restlessness, burnout, refusal to rest.
description: A knight lies in repose upon a tomb, three swords above and one below — peaceful restoration.

name: Five of Swords
upright_meaning: A hollow victory or bitter conflict. Winning at all costs leaves everyone diminished. Choose your battles wisely and seek peaceful resolution.
reversed_meaning: Reconciliation, making amends, moving past conflict.
description: A smirking figure collects fallen swords while two defeated figures walk away — victory without honor.

name: Six of Swords
upright_meaning: Moving away from turbulence toward calmer waters. Though the journey is bittersweet, better times lie ahead. Trust the transition.
reversed_meaning: Stuck in the past, resistance to change, unresolved baggage.
description: A ferryman guides two passengers across water from choppy to calm seas — a transition to peace.

name: Seven of Swords
upright_meaning: Someone may be acting with deception or hidden motives. Use strategic thinking but maintain your integrity. Not everything is as it appears.
reversed_meaning: Coming clean, confession, getting caught, conscience.
description: A figure sneaks away from a camp carrying five swords, leaving two behind — cunning but incomplete deception.

name: Eight of Swords
upright_meaning: You feel trapped, but the prison is of your own making. Challenge your limiting beliefs and you will see the exit has always been there.
reversed_meaning: Self-acceptance, new perspective, freedom from limitations.
description: A blindfolded and bound figure stands surrounded by eight swords — trapped by perception, not reality.

name: Nine of Swords
upright_meaning: Anxiety and worry keep you up at night. The fears in your mind may be worse than reality. Seek support and face your worries head-on.
reversed_meaning: Hope, reaching out for help, recovery from anxiety.
description: A figure sits up in bed, head in hands, nine swords hanging on the dark wall — the agony of mental anguish.

name: Ten of Swords
upright_meaning: Rock bottom has been reached, but the only way now is up. A painful ending clears the way for a new dawn. The worst is behind you.
reversed_meaning: Recovery, regeneration, resisting an inevitable end.
description: A figure lies face down with ten swords in their back, but dawn breaks on the horizon — the darkest hour before dawn.

name: Page of Swords
upright_meaning: Your mind is sharp and hungry for knowledge. Embrace your intellectual curiosity and communicate your ideas with clarity and enthusiasm.
reversed_meaning: Gossip, haste, all talk and no action.
description: A young page holds a sword upright, standing alert on windy ground — the eager student of truth.

name: Knight of Swords
upright_meaning: Charge forward with intellectual precision and unstoppable drive. Your ambition cuts through all obstacles. Swift, decisive action is favored.
reversed_meaning: Recklessness, impatience, unfocused energy.
description: A knight charges at full gallop, sword raised high — the embodiment of fierce mental determination.

name: Queen of Swords
upright_meaning: Speak your truth with clarity and set firm boundaries. Your sharp perception and independent thinking are your greatest assets.
reversed_meaning: Cold-hearted, overly critical, bitter.
description: A stern queen holds her sword upright, gazing forward with clear determination — the queen of honest communication.

name: King of Swords
upright_meaning: Lead with intellectual authority and unwavering ethics. Make decisions based on logic and truth. Your clear thinking commands respect.
reversed_meaning: Tyranny, manipulation, abuse of power.
description: A powerful king holds his sword of truth, seated on a throne carved with butterflies and angels.

name: Ace of Pentacles
upright_meaning: A golden opportunity for material and financial growth. Plant the seed of a new venture and watch prosperity grow with patience and effort.
reversed_meaning: Lost opportunity, lack of planning, poor financial management.
description: A hand emerges from clouds offering a golden pentacle above a lush garden — material abundance awaits.

name: Two of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Juggling multiple priorities with grace. Stay flexible and adaptable as you balance work, finances, and personal life.
reversed_meaning: Overwhelmed, disorganized, financial difficulty.
description: A figure dances while juggling two pentacles connected by an infinity symbol — the art of balance.

name: Three of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Collaboration and skilled craftsmanship produce excellent results. Work with others, share expertise, and take pride in quality work.
reversed_meaning: Lack of teamwork, disharmony in groups, poor quality.
description: A stonemason works on a cathedral while consulting with a monk and architect — mastery through collaboration.

name: Four of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Holding onto financial security and stability. Be mindful that saving is wise, but hoarding out of fear limits abundance.
reversed_meaning: Greed, materialism, excessive spending or excessive saving.
description: A figure clutches four pentacles tightly — on head, under arms, under feet — clinging to material security.

name: Five of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Financial hardship or feeling left out in the cold. Remember that help is available if you look for it. This difficult time will pass.
reversed_meaning: Recovery from financial loss, spiritual growth, finding support.
description: Two impoverished figures walk through snow past an illuminated church window — hardship with hidden help nearby.

name: Six of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Give and receive with an open heart. Generosity flows both ways — share your abundance and accept help when you need it.
reversed_meaning: Strings attached, inequality, one-sided generosity.
description: A wealthy merchant weighs coins on a scale while giving to those in need — balanced generosity.

name: Seven of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Your hard work is growing, but the harvest isn't ready yet. Be patient and trust the process. Long-term investments will pay off.
reversed_meaning: Impatience, lack of reward, wasted effort.
description: A farmer leans on his hoe, gazing at a vine heavy with seven pentacles — waiting for the harvest.

name: Eight of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Dedicate yourself to mastering your craft. Diligent practice and attention to detail will elevate your skills to new heights.
reversed_meaning: Perfectionism, lack of motivation, sloppy work.
description: An artisan carefully carves pentacles one by one, fully absorbed in his craft — the path to mastery.

name: Nine of Pentacles
upright_meaning: You have built a life of abundance through your own efforts. Enjoy the fruits of your labor in comfort and elegance. Financial independence is yours.
reversed_meaning: Overworking, living beyond means, lack of independence.
description: An elegant woman stands in a lush vineyard with a falcon on her hand — self-made luxury and refinement.

name: Ten of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Lasting wealth, family legacy, and long-term security. You are building something that will endure for generations. Financial and familial stability.
reversed_meaning: Family disputes over money, financial failure, loss of legacy.
description: Three generations gather in a wealthy estate adorned with ten pentacles — the tree of life and lasting legacy.

name: Page of Pentacles
upright_meaning: A new opportunity for growth and learning is before you. Approach it with studious dedication and practical ambition.
reversed_meaning: Lack of progress, procrastination, missed learning opportunity.
description: A young page stands in a green field, gazing at a pentacle held in both hands — the eager student of material wisdom.

name: Knight of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Steady, methodical progress toward your goals. Hard work, routine, and patience are your greatest allies. Slow and steady wins the race.
reversed_meaning: Stagnation, laziness, boredom, feeling stuck.
description: A patient knight sits on a stationary horse, gazing at a pentacle — the embodiment of steady, reliable progress.

name: Queen of Pentacles
upright_meaning: Create a warm, secure, and nurturing environment. Your practical wisdom and generosity make you a pillar of strength for others.
reversed_meaning: Self-care neglect, work-life imbalance, smothering.
description: A nurturing queen sits on a throne adorned with nature, cradling a pentacle — the earth mother of abundance.

name: King of Pentacles
upright_meaning: You have achieved material mastery and financial security through disciplined effort. Lead your enterprise with wisdom and provide for those around you.
reversed_meaning: Greed, materialism, poor financial management.
description: A prosperous king sits on a throne decorated with bull carvings, surrounded by abundance — the master of the material realm.
